knowledge.name: Synthetic permit application snapshot
knowledge.detail: Six fictional permits capture applicant, parcel, project, valuation, zoning, status, reviewer, review cycle, and submitted documents.

knowledge.name: Permit rules and statutory schedules
knowledge.detail: Packaged targets, ordered review desks, intake-document rules, duplicate criteria, and zoning references drive fixed decisions.

knowledge.name: Review checklist and fee references
knowledge.detail: Synthetic checklist templates and valuation-based fee schedules support review scope and estimates, never compliance or billing actions.

knowledge.name: Inspector board and coverage records
knowledge.detail: Fixed inspections, specialties, zones, dates, statuses, and available slots support coverage review without changing assignments.

intelligence_processing.name: Backlog and complaint-risk ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares open permits with statutory clocks and correction cycles to rank overdue work and recommend reviewer intervention.

intelligence_processing.name: Intake completeness and duplicate triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Checks required documents and matching applicant-parcel records, then recommends accept, reject, or redirect without mutating a case.

intelligence_processing.name: Review routing and due-date preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Classifies permit type, returns ordered review desks, and calculates the synthetic target date for technician and reviewer approval.

intelligence_processing.name: Applicant update drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Turns current permit evidence into prioritized draft status updates; staff review and send them through separately approved channels.

intelligence_processing.name: Permit review decision support
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns status, reviewer, zoning references, checklist scope, and fee estimates without approval, compliance, invoice, or payment claims.

intelligence_processing.name: Inspection coverage coordination
intelligence_processing.detail: Surfaces the inspection board and specialty-matched coverage for inspector review without booking, reassigning, or notifying anyone.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file RAPP agent exposes seven natural-language permit workflows through local chat, streaming, and tool routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Seven skills and two synthetic knowledge files reproduce five validated cases while the downloadable agent remains unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first staff responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Permit technicians, reviewers, customer-service staff, managers, and inspectors receive concise facts, drafts, and next steps.

management_reporting.name: Backlog escalation brief
management_reporting.detail: Ranks overdue permits, complaint risk, review cycles, and assigned reviewers so managers can authorize intervention priorities.

management_reporting.name: Front-counter intake queue
management_reporting.detail: Shows duplicate and incomplete submissions, required documents, review desks, and target dates for technician approval.

management_reporting.name: Applicant communication queue
management_reporting.detail: Prioritizes permit-specific draft updates for customer-service review; the agent never sends a message or changes a permit case.

management_reporting.name: Inspection coverage board
management_reporting.detail: Lists scheduled and pending inspections with inspector specialties and coverage for human assignment and field approval.

tools.name: BuildingPermitProcessingAgent portable tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements seven deterministic workflows over packaged synthetic permit and inspection records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated skills-and-knowledge experience; the downloadable manual build is Draft and requires explicit publication approval.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
tools.detail: Cited future read-only seam for permit cases; no live connector exists and the agent never creates, updates, closes, or approves a case.

tools.name: SharePoint
tools.detail: Cited future read-only seam for plans and policy documents; the package currently uses two synthetic knowledge files.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Cited future seam for reviewer and inspector coordination; the package sends no messages, assignments, or approval requests.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from deterministic agent or packaged skill evidence.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every permit, applicant, address, reviewer, inspector, date, standard, fee, status, and recommendation is fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Seven preserved permit workflows
supporting_features.detail: Backlog, intake, applicant updates, status, checklist, inspector assignment, and fee estimation remain independently routable.

supporting_features.name: Reviewer and inspector approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Human reviewers approve permit decisions and handoffs; inspectors approve coverage and field action before any operational change.

supporting_features.name: No permit-case mutation
supporting_features.detail: The agent never approves, denies, issues, reopens, edits, closes, routes, or otherwise changes a permit or service case.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous communications or assignments
supporting_features.detail: Applicant updates stay drafts; reviewer and inspector assignment, booking, cancellation, and notification remain human-controlled.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed and non-legal handling
supporting_features.detail: Unknown records are not substituted; zoning and checklist outputs are references, not legal advice or code-compliance findings.

supporting_features.name: Draft publication and future-write controls
supporting_features.detail: The release build is unpublished; production starts read-only and any future write needs governance review and explicit human approval.
